description.en: Opens a folder in DeepSeek Harness from the OS: a Windows Explorer context-menu verb, a macOS Finder Quick Action and QSpace service, and the dsh-open launcher that starts or hands off to the desktop app.
description.zh: 从系统里用 DeepSeek Harness 打开文件夹：Windows 资源管理器右键动词、macOS Finder 快速操作与 QSpace 服务，以及负责启动或交接桌面端的 dsh-open 启动器。
